steps.content: The patients overcome with Mania have already been subdued. Lavina is comforting the others who are still in shock.

steps.speaker: Mania Patient
steps.content: They're lying about the resettlement and getting us away from the Black Ring! Bunch of liars!

steps.speaker: Mania Patient
steps.content: They say we're all just fodder for the Black Ring. They want to throw us into those abandoned satellite towns in WhiteSands, then let us be wiped out by a Tide of Ashes or some natural disaster!

steps.speaker: Mania Patient
steps.content: This is the Purge Order! They're already preparing to purge us!

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Calm down. That's just a rumor. We've been in touch with the satellite town dwellers. The living conditions are tough, but they still have ways to get supplies and protect themselves.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Besides, not even Burns would have dared to implement such an inhumane practice. The authorities would be condemned.
Lavina grabs the patient's hand, giving her a shot of anti-Mania sedative while calming her down.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: See, we've got enough supplies and help from our Outlander friends here. Don't panic, it'll only exacerbate the Mania. We're all here with you, just relax.

steps.speaker: Mania Patient
steps.content: They say you've found a way out, that we can still survive if we come here. Is that true? Can you escape Paradeisos? Can you escape the Black Ring?

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Of course! None of us have given up yet!
He turns to seek Crache's support only to find his boss gone.
[Scene Change] Corridor

Crache steps out of the ward, sighing. They're already used to seeing Mania patients among the refugees and know how to deal with such an emergency. But in the end, the sheer number of cases still takes a toll on everyone's mood.
With that thought, she hears a sneer next to her. A disheveled refugee is leaning against the corner, his seemingly injured body wrapped in untidy bandages.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: There's still room inside. It would be better to let a doctor take a look.

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: Haha... Give me a break. I can't stand the nonsense those idiots inside are spouting. You're only here because you think the same, no?
Crache isn't interested in the conversation, so she turns to go, leaving the man to his own ramblings.

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: Kids will be kids... If there was a way out, would Syndicate have come to this?

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: The Legion and Rustfire have both failed. What can a bunch of refugees do? Nothing will change. There's no escaping this.

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: Even if they're all just spreading rumors, between a bunch of kids and a group of men in black, even a fool knows who to trust. Conspiracy theories always sell... Goodness!
He looks up to find Crache back to his side again, watching him anxiously.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...What conspiracy theories? Who are the men in black?

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: Well... Literally a bunch of people dressed in black. Some in raincoats, some carrying black umbrellas. Say they're giving us a kind warning.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...Umbrellas?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Besides the elites from the Executive Committee, the FAC, the 9th Agency, the MBCC, and Paradeisos, there's another group to be wary of... The black rain gear wholesalers who never speak properly and always have a creepy glowing eye stuck on their faces.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Those are most likely the loonies from the Underground. You see one, you kill one. No second thought.
